correctness.rationale: Analytic forest weighted-coverage formula; exact cycle infection expectations from two edge-disjoint routes; algebraically derived Δ_{i,j}; global upper bound by root-neighbor pair; strictly increasing reciprocal-power classification; after a nonempty vaccine background the residual graph is a forest. Exactly enumerated rational edge states across all vaccine subsets of C3–C8 and 1,441 Prüfer trees; universal validity rests on proof, not finite computation.

value.rationale: Submodularity is a mathematically substantive diminishing-returns property required for greedy vaccination approximation guarantees. This finding supplies an all-n exact phase boundary, a unique extremal pair that first breaks submodularity, a complete individual-pair switching law, and the minimum graph order of failure. Generic non-submodularity counterexamples were already known, but they do not settle this structural classification. Restricted contact model and bibliographic risk are explicitly stated.
